plugin.vaultwarden.title: Vaultwarden
plugin.vaultwarden.description: The server's admin panel: its users, organisations and settings, without a browser tab on /admin.
vwadmin.tokenHint: The token itself, not its Argon2 hash: the server checks it against the hash.
vwadmin.inviteHint: The server sends an invitation to this address; the person sets up the account themselves.
vwadmin.confirm.disable: {who} will be logged out and cannot log in until enabled again.
vwadmin.confirm.deauth: {who} is logged out on every device and has to log in again.
vwadmin.confirm.removeTwoFactor: {who} loses every second factor and logs in with the master password alone until they set one up again.
vwadmin.confirm.delete: {who} and everything of theirs — items, attachments, memberships — disappears from the server. There is no undo.
vwadmin.deleteOrgHint: Its items and collections disappear for every member.
vwadmin.deleteOrgWarn: “{name}” disappears with all its items, collections and memberships. There is no undo.
vwadmin.backupHint: SQLite only: the server writes a copy next to its database.
vwadmin.forgetHint: The admin token leaves the keychain; unlocking again means pasting it again.
err.vwadminHttps: The panel is reached over https only: the token travels with every request
err.vwadminRateLimited: The server refuses logins for a while: too many tries. Wait a minute
err.vwadminBadToken: The admin token is not accepted
err.vwadminDisabled: The admin panel is switched off on this server (no ADMIN_TOKEN)
err.vwadminSession: The panel's session ran out and could not be renewed
err.vwadminAnswer: The panel's answer does not parse: {reason}
err.vwadminBadId: That is not a valid identifier
vwadmin.unlockBody: This server has Vaultwarden's admin panel. Paste the admin token (ADMIN_TOKEN) to unlock it: the token goes into the macOS keychain, sealed with a key from your vault and read back only behind Touch ID.
err.vwadminLocked: The admin panel is locked: paste the admin token
err.vwadminNoServer: There is no account, so no server to manage
vwadmin.noMemberships: Not a member of any organisation
vwadmin.readonlyHint: These are set by the server's environment variables when it starts, and cannot be changed from here: the name under each caption is the variable.
vwadmin.overriddenHint: Set in the panel: it overrides what the environment says
vwadmin.resetHint: Everything set in the panel is removed: the defaults and the environment's values come back.
vwadmin.resetWarn: Every setting changed in the panel returns to its default or to the environment's value. There is no undo.
vwadmin.resetDone: The settings are back to the defaults
err.vwadminSettingNotEditable: “{name}” cannot be changed from the panel
vwadmin.membersYours: You manage this organisation: people can be added and removed here, as you.
vwadmin.membersNotYours: The panel changes roles only. Adding and removing people is done by the organisation's owner or admin — joining hands over the organisation's key, which only its members hold.
vwadmin.addToOrgHint: An invitation goes to this address; once they accept, confirm them in the organisation.
vwadmin.envHint: Set by an environment variable; changed on the server and a restart
vwadmin.whoToAddPlaceholder: Pick a user or type an email
vwadmin.whoToAddHint: Users of this server are offered below; any other address is taken on Enter or a comma.
err.orgRoleNotYours: That role cannot be given from here
vwadmin.choiceHint: all for everyone, none for nobody, else addresses separated by commas
vwadmin.secretKeep: Left empty, it stays as it is
vwadmin.tokenWhere: The admin token is kept in the keychain only, sealed with a key from the vault, and read back behind your fingerprint.
